terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.s1_text: Welcome to Venezuela Inmuebles. By using the platform, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.s2_text: Venezuela Inmuebles is a real estate listings portal that helps people search for properties and connect with advertisers. It is not a party to a sale or rental transaction and does not manage payments, contracts or viewings. Listing information is provided by the person who posts it.
terms.s3_text: When listing a property, you represent that:
terms.s3_li1: You have the right or authorization to advertise the property.
terms.s3_li2: The photos and description represent the property being listed.
terms.s3_li3: Information about location, price, availability and terms is accurate and kept up to date.
terms.s3_text2: Misleading or fraudulent listings, listings for properties that are not authorized for marketing, and content that violates the law or third-party rights are prohibited.
terms.s4_text: Credit features, if available, are subject to the terms displayed on the platform before a transaction is confirmed.
terms.s5_text: Spam, fraud, false listings, offensive content and sharing another person’s personal data without authorization are not allowed.
terms.s6_text: The platform does not guarantee the accuracy or availability of listings and does not replace inspection of a property, its documents or agreed terms. Users should carry out their own checks and act with due diligence.
terms.s7_text: We may update these terms. Changes will be posted on this page with the date of revision.
terms.s8_text: For questions about these terms: legal@venezuela-inmuebles.online

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_text: We collect the information you provide when registering (name, email, phone, location) and your listing information (photos, descriptions, prices).
privacy.s3_text: We don't sell or share your personal data with third parties. Your email is never publicly visible unless you choose so. Your contact information is only shared with your consent.
privacy.s4_text: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and secure storage.
privacy.s5_text: You can request the deletion of your account and all your data at any time from your profile settings or by writing to privacidad@venezuela-inmuebles.online.
privacy.s6_text: We use essential storage for site functionality and security, and optional analytics cookies (including Google Analytics 4 with Google Consent Mode) only if you accept them. You can update your choice anytime via 'Cookie preferences' in the footer or in your browser settings.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Practical information for exploring, listing and learning about properties in Venezuela.
faq.q1: How can I assess a property before deciding?
faq.a1: Review the listing details and photos, speak with the advertiser and visit the property. Verify the documents and terms with independent professionals before signing or paying.
faq.q2: Do I need an account to list a property?
faq.a2: You need to sign in to start a listing. If you do not have an account, you can create one through the sign-up option.
faq.q3: What types of properties can I find?
faq.a3: Explore houses, apartments, land and commercial spaces for sale or rent. Availability depends on the listings posted.
faq.a4: Credits are an optional feature that may give a listing more visibility. Review the information and terms shown in your account before confirming any transaction.
faq.q5: Where can I check credit options?
faq.a5: Visit the Credits section in your account to review current information. Do not make payments based on messages from outside the platform.
faq.q6: Does Venezuela Inmuebles handle payments, contracts or viewings?
faq.a6: No. Interested parties arrange viewings and agree on terms directly. The platform does not replace legal, technical or financial advice.
faq.q7: How do I report a suspicious listing?
faq.a7: Email soporte@venezuela-inmuebles.online with the listing link and details that will help us review it.
faq.a8: The listed price and currency appear on the property page. Confirm the final amount, additional costs and terms with the advertiser before proceeding.
faq.q9: How do I contact the advertiser?
faq.a9: Open the property page and use the contact options available there. These may include messages, phone or WhatsApp, depending on the information shared.
faq.q10: What types of transactions can I search for?
faq.a10: You can explore property listings for sale or rent. Use the location and property-type filters to narrow your results.
faq.q11: Can I list a property for sale or rent?
faq.a11: When creating a listing, select the appropriate transaction type and complete the requested details. Review the information before submitting it.
faq.noAnswerDesc: Write to us and we’ll help

installApp.title: Install the Venezuela Inmuebles App
installApp.subtitle: You don't need to search any app store. Venezuela Inmuebles is a progressive web app (PWA) that installs directly from your browser. In 3 steps!
installApp.androidReq: Requirement: Use Google Chrome on your Android
installApp.androidStep1Desc: Make sure you're on the correct URL. If you already have the page open, great.
installApp.androidStep2Title: Tap the 3-dot menu (⋮) at the top right
installApp.androidStep3Title: Find and tap "Install app" or "Add to home screen"
installApp.androidStep3Desc: Depending on your Chrome version, you'll see one of these options. A banner at the bottom may also say "Install Venezuela Inmuebles".
installApp.androidStep4Desc: A confirmation dialog will appear. Tap "Install". Done! You now have Venezuela Inmuebles as an app on your home screen.
installApp.iosReq: Requirement: Use Safari on your iPhone
installApp.iosStep1Desc: ⚠️ Important: Doesn't work with Chrome, Firefox or other browsers on iPhone. Only Safari allows app installation.
installApp.iosStep2Desc: It's in the Safari bar at the bottom of the screen (on iPhones with Face ID it's at the top in the bar).
installApp.iosStep3Title: Scroll down until you see "Add to Home Screen"
installApp.iosStep3Desc: It's a bit further down in the share menu. If you don't see it, scroll more.
installApp.iosStep4Desc: You can change the name if you want. Then tap "Add" in the top right corner. Done!
installApp.why1desc: An icon on your home screen. Open with one tap, no bookmark searching.
installApp.why2desc: Loads without the browser bar. Experience similar to a native app.
installApp.why3desc: If notifications are available on your device, you can receive alerts without opening the browser.
installApp.why4desc: You can view the last page you visited even without connection.

floatingChat.greeting: Searching, renting or listing a property? Browse the FAQ or contact us through the contact page.

homePage.metaTitle: Property in Venezuela: houses and apartments for sale and rent | Venezuela Inmuebles
homePage.metaDescription: Buy, sell or rent property in Venezuela. Houses, apartments, land, retail and offices with verified advertisers and direct contact.
homePage.heroLead: Houses, apartments, land and commercial spaces for sale and rent across the country. List for free and talk directly to the advertiser.
homePage.valueOneText: Create your listing with photos, measurements and price. The Free plan costs nothing.
homePage.valueTwoText: Free identity verification so buyers can trust who they are talking to.
homePage.valueThreeText: Messaging, WhatsApp or a call. No middlemen, no commission.
homePage.featuredLead: A selection of well-presented properties from verified advertisers.
homePage.featuredEmptyText: In the meantime, here is how your listing will look. Publish yours and it will appear here.
homePage.sampleNoteText: this is how your property will look once published.

homePage.ownerLead: Create the listing, receive enquiries and manage everything from your dashboard. Working as an agent or agency? Bring your team and publish at scale.
homePage.stepOneText: Photos, location, measurements and price in a guided form.
homePage.stepTwoText: Free, with your ID and account type. Verified listings get more enquiries.
homePage.stepThreeText: Talk to buyers by messaging, WhatsApp or phone.
homePage.plansTitle: Choose how much you want to list
homePage.plansLead: Start free. When you need more listings, photos or promotional credits, move up without a lock-in.
homePage.plansNote: 30-day free trial on any plan. No credit card, no automatic billing: when it ends the account returns to the Free plan with 3 active listings.
homePage.closingTitle: Your next property is one search away.

diagnostico.title: Photo upload & AI diagnostics
diagnostico.subtitle: Check from your session whether photo uploads (R2) and AI (Gemini) work on the server.
diagnostico.loginRequired: Sign in to run the diagnostics (use the same account you publish with).
diagnostico.photosDesc: Uploads a real test file to the bucket and verifies environment variables and write permissions.
diagnostico.aiDesc: Sends a sample description to the AI and checks it returns full-length text.
diagnostico.running: Testing… this may take a few seconds
diagnostico.photosOk: R2 storage OK — photo uploads should work when publishing
diagnostico.photosFail: R2 storage is failing — check the variables marked with ✗
diagnostico.aiFail: The AI did not respond correctly:
diagnostico.hint: If any R2 variable shows ✗, add or fix it in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables and redeploy. If the write test fails with AccessDenied, the R2 API token lacks the «Object Read & Write» permission in Cloudflare.
